palette.notes: Measured 16-19 colours per sheet (idle 18, cuteness 19, defend 17, death 16, breaking 16), UI included. Ramps hue-shift both ways (+30 to +46 deg warm ramps, -13 to -38 deg cool ones); near-zero dithering (1.4-2.0%).

lighting: Flat top-left light on tiny sprites; drama comes from flashes instead: a full white frame on a hit, a bright shield bubble on defend, white impact stars on death.
silhouette: Big-head small-body heroes (red cape, blue hood) and blobby monsters that read at 1x; the cuteness panel shows the rule as overlays: big forehead, low eyes, a triangle-shaped body, round soft shapes.

motion.timing: Even holds: idle 60 frames at 100 ms (6 s cycle), defend 34 at 80 ms, death 22 at 100 ms, breaking 59 drawings at 80 ms with one 400 ms hold. Cuteness mixes 30, 60, 100 and 120 ms holds; the 30 ms one is a blink.

texture: Clean flat clusters, almost no dithering; debris and sparks (breaking pot shards, death particles, shield chips) carry the texture.
camera: Static tutorial panels, one idea per box; each idea plays as its own small looping scene side by side, so the eye compares variants.

acting.enters: No entrances; characters already stand in place, and new beats arrive as events: a projectile flies in from the right, a pot drops from above.
acting.acts: Idles breathe and blink at different rhythms per character; defend shows block, shield bubble and recoil; death shows hit flash, knock-back, collapse to a lying pose; the pot falls, cracks and bursts into shards.
acting.exits: Exit by death: the body falls flat and stays, or explodes into particles that fade; the broken pot leaves pieces on the floor.
acting.depth: All in one plane; a close-up face panel next to the full-body sprite plays the same moment at two scales (bust reacts, body acts).

techniques: idle that breathes: 1-2 px body bob plus a blink, each character on its own rhythm
cute proportions: big forehead, low-set eyes, triangle body, rounded shapes
30 ms blink frame inside 120 ms holds
one white hit-flash frame before the knock-back
defend = anticipation pose, shield bubble, small recoil, settle
death = flash, knock-back, fall, lie still; or burst into particles that fade
object break: fall, crack, explode into 4-6 shards that stay on the floor
loop the whole beat with a hold so it can play again
feel: big-head cute proportions + breathing idle with blinks + one white flash on every hit = small sprites with real personality
for_fred: Give Fred a breathing idle (1-2 px bob, a blink on its own beat) so he lives while Robert talks, then let one beat end in an exit by event: a white flash, he gets knocked off-frame, a held empty beat, and he pops back in. Pixie can do a defend beat (brace, bubble, recoil) when a point is attacked. Do not loop the same idle for the whole reel.
